title: His devotion to his horn and care of his lips
summary: He never left his horn or lent his mouthpiece, got a blister on his lower lip and used antiseptic.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Lips, teeth and breath: the physical craft of brass playing
